 def test_complete_predecessors_and_exact_reviewed_edits_preserved(self):
  import hashlib
  spec=json.loads((ROOT/'tests/fixtures/short-position-ambiguity/preservation.json').read_bytes())
  for path,item in spec['sources'].items():
   raw=(ROOT/item['file']).read_bytes();self.assertEqual(len(raw),item['bytes'])

   old=raw.decode('utf-8');parts=[];offset=0
   for edit in spec['edits'][path]:
    self.assertGreaterEqual(edit['start'],offset)

   parts.append(old[offset:]);self.assertEqual(''.join(parts),(ROOT/path).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
